source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"Assign the most unstable child because an unrestricted RN license establishes competence in every specialty.","B":"Give a full independent PICU assignment without orientation because staffing need takes priority over experience.","C":"Assign any available PICU workload and allow the nurse to seek help only after a problem develops.","D":"Match the assignment to verified skills and provide orientation, supervision, or workload modification as needed."}}
source_row.rationale: NCSBN expects nurses to recognize professional limitations, use appropriate resources, practice within legal scope, and consider competence in assignments. Option D protects clients while allowing appropriate support and orientation. Licensure alone does not establish competence for every specialty assignment, so A, B, and C are unsafe.
source_row.source_detail: Management of Care — Legal Rights and Responsibilities/Assignment and Delegation activity statements: provide care within legal scope, recognize limitations of self and others and use resources, consider client acuity and staff competence when making assignments. 2026 NCLEX-RN Test Plan effective 2026-04-01 through 2029-03-31; currentness live-rechecked 2026-08-15.
